text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Act Two began with an overwhelming victory 
by T.M. Opera O. —It was as if she had 
completely transformed, leaving her former 
formidable rivals far behind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taking that to heart, Narita Top Road and 
Admire Vega ran a mock race with her. Just 
what would the result be—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
TM Opera O had grown tremendously 
stronger. Through her battles with her 
worthy rivals, she had awakened as a true 
powerhouse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring)— The showdown 
between Narita Top Road and TM Opera O is 
right around the corner.
